chapter_title: Exploring the Investigative World of Science
executive_summary: Chapter 1 introduces students to the investigative framework of science, presenting science not as a collection of static facts to memorize, but as a dynamic process of active inquiry, systematic observation, hypothesis formation, and controlled experimentation. Using the 'Root and Kite' metaphor, it grounds scientific questioning in everyday experiences while encouraging creative, soaring hypotheses.
key_takeaways: Master core concepts of Exploring the Investigative World of Science.
Understand real-world applications and experimental activities.
Analyze cause-and-effect relations and scientific definitions.

essential_vocabulary.definition: The systematic approach to discovering how the natural world works through questioning, observing, testing, and analyzing data.
A proposed, testable explanation for an observation based on available evidence.
